title: Selling What You Carve: Pricing CNC Relief Carvings, What Sells, and What the Licence Allows
excerpt: A pricing formula that survives contact with a craft fair, the numbers behind it, what actually sells (from our own sales data), how to photograph and present a carving so it fetches its price, where to sell, and exactly what our file licence lets you do.
seo_title: How to Price and Sell CNC Relief Carvings (Formula, What Sells, Licence)
seo_description: How to sell CNC relief carvings: a pricing formula with real numbers, what designs sell best by category, photographing and packaging carved panels, Etsy versus fairs versus local, and what a commercial STL licence does and does not allow.

email.subject: What to charge for a carving, and what sells
email.intro:
Two questions arrive together, usually the week after someone's first good carving: what should I charge for this, and would anyone buy it?

The new guide answers both with numbers rather than encouragement: a pricing formula that holds up at a craft fair, what our own sales data says sells, how to photograph and pack a panel so it fetches its price, and exactly what the file licence lets you do with what you carve.
